findings.title: Visibility audit table still reports pre-fix counts
findings.evidence: The table still says `mechanics only — a PARTIAL response | 7` and `the builder's empty shape | 6`, although the later text says both docks disappear and the current handler keeps only `page-head` and `headline`.
findings.failure_scenario: Dispatch the builder’s empty payload (`controls: null`, one `sim-empty` section). A published-page reader sees only `page-head`, `headline`, and the inserted empty section, with zero control docks—3 rendered component IDs, not the documented 6. A mechanics-only response with controls renders 6 components, not 7. Consequently a maintainer reading the recorded browser verification gets false evidence about the bytes now under review.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the mechanics-only row from 7 to 6 and the empty row from 6 to 3, explicitly noting the rendered dock counts. Also remove the adjacent stale charts.js comments that still describe controls or `sim-mix-group` as keep-set members.

overall_explanation: The reader-visible recompute fix is sound for every response shape the current SMP builder can produce, including restoration after empty or partial responses. The only defect found is stale verification documentation left behind by that fix; it does not affect the published page itself.
